idea.title: Your friends on a 2am call
idea.summary: Five kinds of friends on a 2 AM call, made to be sent to the one who is number three.
hookOptions: every friend group has a number 3

scenes.say: Every friend group has a number three.

scenes.title: your friends at 2am

items.title: bas 5 min
items.line: says it at 1:58. still talking at 4:10

items.title: the hmm machine
items.line: you pour your heart out. they say hmm

items.title: voice note novelist
items.line: sends a 9 minute voice note. starts with 'ok so'

items.title: asleep mid sentence
items.line: 'wait i have to tell you som'

items.title: always online
items.line: replies in 2 seconds. never says why they're up

scenes.say: Bas five minutes. The hmm machine. The voice note novelist. Asleep mid sentence. And the one always online.

post.caption:

Which one are you?
Someone's always up on randomtalker.com
